title: Cache and reuse no-match RuleMatch allocations in ruleTestSync
body:
This PR optimizes scanning performance by caching and reusing the fallback `RuleMatchKind.noMatch` object on the active `Source` (`src._noMatchCache ||= ...`).

Since most files in a scan do not match any pattern, caching this allocation eliminates thousands of redundant object creations and substantially reduces memory pressure and GC pauses during directory traversal.
